# T3.1 — Publish metrics to the telemetry service

## Spec

Emit request-rate and error-rate counters to the telemetry service on a fixed
interval.

## Scope

The exporter and its configuration. Dashboards are somebody else's problem.

## Acceptance

- Counters appear in staging within one interval of startup.
- The daemon starts and serves normally when telemetry is unreachable.

## Blocked (2026-08-03T16:40:00Z)

No staging credentials for the telemetry service; requested from platform, no ETA.

## Note

`blocked` is for the world needing to change — a credential, an upstream merge,
an answer — as distinct from `needs-review`, which means a human must look at
*this task*. Both keep it out of the frontier, and both are reversible with
`tp task reopen`.

Note the cost: this also holds up T3.2, which is why a blocked task deserves a
reason specific enough to act on later.
